summary: Tempest Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting that its reconvened special meeting, originally convened and adjourned July 27, 2026 and again August 17, 2026, was called to order September 15, 2026 and adjourned once more to October 14, 2026 because insufficient votes existed to approve a charter amendment eliminating supermajority voting requirements and permitting stockholder action by written consent. Quorum was 10,760,144 shares, or 72.7% of 14,806,997 shares outstanding as of the May 28, 2026 record date. Approval requires 75% of votes entitled to be cast; the proposal is unchanged and prior proxies remain valid. This is a routine governance meeting adjournment, not a special situation.
